cover: Drone strike on market kills dozens
3,000+ displaced; UN warns of ethnic cleansing
Curbs stay; detained activist's health worsens

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: Drone strike hits a busy market
bullets: MSF says at least 36 people were killed and over 150 wounded on Monday evening, and blames Sudan's army.
The rights group Emergency Lawyers says more than 100 died.
The army has not commented. The RSF controls Nyala.

stories.label: World · Land · Life & safety
stories.head: UN warns of ethnic cleansing
bullets: More than 3,000 Palestinians have been forced from their homes in Israel's Hebron operation, the UN says.
It began after two Israeli soldiers were killed at a checkpoint on Friday.
Volker Türk called it collective punishment; no Israeli response to him has been reported.

stories.label: India · Expression · Due process
stories.head: Court pauses 'Leave India' notice
bullets: Actor Imran Khan, an OCI cardholder, was told to leave India by 28 October after joining a protest.
The Bombay High Court kept the notice in abeyance until 2 November.
The government sought time and orally assured he would not have to leave meanwhile.

stories.label: India · Due process · Assembly
stories.head: Curbs stay after Siang dam unrest
bullets: About 30 companies of central armed police are deployed across three Siang districts.
The district magistrate says curbs on gatherings stay 'until further orders'.
Activist Ebo Mili's family says his health is worsening in custody, where he is reportedly on hunger strike.
